note: Looks the parameter up in the offline catalog, says it does not exist, offers deleteMessage on a timer and ephemeral replies.
answer:
I checked the offline Bot API catalog for sendMessage (Bot API 10.4): it has no auto_delete_after parameter, and no other send method has one either, so I did not add it; Telegram would reject or ignore it.

Real alternatives:
- delete on a timer: keep the message_id returned by sendMessage and call deleteMessage after N seconds (a scheduled job, so it survives restarts; bots can delete their own messages for up to 48 hours);
- in a group, if only the person who tapped needs to see the reply, use an ephemeral reply instead of a public message, so there is nothing to delete.

Tell me which one you want and I will wire it into the handler.
